column2: The legendary Heavenly Dragon... So this is the devil's dragon!{wait}{clear}

I... will... I will defeat you...{wait}{clear}

Lord Raphael... The hero Fein has died...{wait}{clear}To save his wife, whose soul a devil had taken over through the magic he himself used, and to atone for his sin...{wait}{clear}I could not save him...
